map.UUID v3/v5 是基于名字的确定性 UUID：把「命名空间 UUID 的: UUID v3/v5 are name-based deterministic UUIDs: concatenate the 16 bytes of the namespace UUID with the name's bytes, hash them (v3 uses MD5, v5 uses SHA-1), take the first 16 bytes, then set the version to 5 and the variant to 10. Because the output is determined by the input, the same namespace + name always yields the same UUID, ideal as a stable identifier derived from a business key (e.g., namespace by domain + username to make a user ID). Note it is not unpredictable and must not be used as a key or token.
